t: Data Transformation Pipeline - Signature build-tool concept
title: Data Transformation Pipeline - Signature build-tool concept
definition: Applies repeatable sequences of data-processing operations.
description:
Every build an AI undertakes passes through Data Transformation Pipeline: Applies repeatable sequences of data-processing operations. The catalog lists it among the thousand fundamental build tools because no serious building happens without it. This database is its Signature edition - the concept rebuilt as a deterministic framework with seven pillars, grounded in real techniques and standards, and taught through a ladder of runnable drills.

The Signature line treats Data Transformation Pipeline as infrastructure, not inspiration. Infrastructure has contracts: given these inputs, in this state, the Data Transformation Pipeline produces that output, and anyone can verify it. The seven pillars are those contracts made concrete - each owns one responsibility, each can be tested alone, and together they compose into the full capability. The technique records show the real public knowledge the pillars stand on.

Work through this database the way you would commission a machine: read the charter in the overview, inspect each pillar, check the techniques against your own knowledge, then run the drills. Every record includes a program you can execute with node - the Data Transformation Pipeline is demonstrated, not merely described.

t: Signature Scrubber - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
title: Signature Scrubber - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
definition: The Scrubber component of the Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework, owning scrubber. Signature concept.
description:
The Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework decomposes the capability (Applies repeatable sequences of data-processing operations.) into seven pillars, and the Scrubber is the one that owns the framework's scrubber responsibilities. Owning a responsibility means three things in the Signature line: the pillar declares exactly what it accepts, it publishes exactly what it guarantees, and it logs enough evidence that a third party can replay its work and reach the same conclusion.

This discipline pays off when builds go wrong, because they always eventually do. When a Data Transformation Pipeline result looks suspicious, the auditor does not re-run the whole build and hope; they replay the Scrubber's log, check its guarantees against its inputs, and find the fault at its source. The pillar is thus both a worker and a witness - it does the work and it testifies about the work.

Try it yourself: this record's demo runs the Scrubber's core procedure on a worked example. The program is plain JavaScript - save it as demo.js and run it with node, or press Run in the Demo Lab. Change the inputs and re-run; the procedure is deterministic, so you can verify every claim the description makes.

Signature framing: this pillar is part of the Signature line's original design for Data Transformation Pipeline. It is labeled a Signature concept throughout - an engineered proposal, not an established public fact. The techniques it relies on are real and cited in the technique records of this database.

t: Signature Deduper - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
title: Signature Deduper - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
definition: The Deduper component of the Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework, owning deduper. Signature concept.
description:
The Deduper is a load-bearing component of the Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework. Its contract is narrow and absolute: within the framework, everything concerning the framework's deduper responsibilities belongs to the Deduper, and the Deduper answers for it. This separation is what makes the framework testable - the Deduper can be exercised alone, with declared inputs and checkable outputs, long before it is wired into a full build.

In operation the Deduper works like this. A build request arrives carrying the Data Transformation Pipeline charter (applies repeatable sequences of data-processing operations.). The Deduper reads its portion of the charter, performs its transformation, and hands a verified intermediate result to the next pillar. If its checks fail, it stops the line and reports exactly what was wrong, instead of passing corruption downstream. That fail-fast discipline is the Signature line's signature.

Signature-concept illustration: a builder asks for a small dataclean job that needs Data Transformation Pipeline. The Deduper takes the request's deduper responsibilities slice, applies the framework's deterministic procedure, and returns its result with a proof of what it did. Run this record's demo program to see the Deduper's core logic execute on a concrete example - the same logic, the same result, every run.

Signature framing: this pillar is part of the Signature line's original design for Data Transformation Pipeline. It is labeled a Signature concept throughout - an engineered proposal, not an established public fact. The techniques it relies on are real and cited in the technique records of this database.

t: Signature Imputer - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
title: Signature Imputer - Data Transformation Pipeline framework pillar
definition: The Imputer component of the Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework, owning imputer. Signature concept.
description:
Inside the Signature Data Transformation Pipeline framework, the Imputer owns the framework's imputer responsibilities. Frameworks fail when responsibilities blur; the Signature line prevents that by giving each pillar a written contract, and the Imputer's contract is the sharpest of the seven. It accepts declared inputs, applies one deterministic transformation, and emits a result that any other pillar - or any auditor - can verify independently.

What distinguishes the Signature Imputer from an ad-hoc script is the verification loop. Every execution is checked against the charter (Applies repeatable sequences of data-processing operations.). If the result cannot be justified against the charter, it is rejected and the build halts with a diagnostic instead of a silent wrong answer. Deterministic builds are not a slogan here; they are the acceptance test.

Walk through it concretely. A Data cleaning and transformation build needs Data Transformation Pipeline, so the framework invokes the Imputer on the the framework's imputer responsibilities portion of the work. The demo program attached to this record executes the pillar's essential algorithm on sample data - run it with node and watch each step print its reasoning. Same seed, same output: that reproducibility is the entire point.

Signature framing: this pillar is part of the Signature line's original design for Data Transformation Pipeline. It is labeled a Signature concept throughout - an engineered proposal, not an established public fact. The techniques it relies on are real and cited in the technique records of this database.
